text: Skip to main content About Form 5300, Application for Determination for Employee Benefit Plan More In Forms and Instructions Current year Prior year Accessible eBooks Browser-friendly forms and publications Mobile-friendly forms Post release changes to forms Order forms and publications Help with forms and instructions Comment on tax forms and publications File this Form 5300 to request a determination letter from the IRS for the initial qualification of a defined benefit or a defined contribution plan and the exempt status of any related trust. Current revision Form 5300 must be submitted electronically through Pay.gov . You can access the most recent revision of the form at Pay.gov. To submit Form 5300, you must: Register for an account on Pay.gov Enter “5300” in the search box and select Form 5300. Complete the form.
